summary: Air Industries Group filed an 8-K disclosing a Twelfth Amendment to its Loan and Security Agreement with Webster Bank, extending the maturity of revolving credit and term loans to November 30, 2026. Subordinated note holders Michael and Robert Taglich concurrently extended their notes' maturity to December 1, 2026. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation. No price, premium, or structural terms apply. The filing is a material agreement entry under Item 1.01 with no change of control, tender, or strategic transaction. What to watch: potential refinancing or liquidity developments ahead of the November 2026 maturity.
